name: Sika ViscoCrete-190 SC
paste:
SIKA® VISCOCRETE®-190 SC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika_viscocrete_-190sc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC is a high range water reducer based on Sika’s ViscoCrete® polycarboxylate polymer technology.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC is designed for high quality shotcrete and may also be used for the production of high performance concrete and Self Compacting Concrete (SCC). Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC is a high range water reducer that provides excellent plasticity and slump life. It is fully compatible with the entire range of Sika® Sigunit . Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC can be combined with accelerating or retarding admixtures to achieve required compressive strength and setting time.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High Range Water Reducing Admixture
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC meets the requirements for AS1478 HWR type.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Water Reduction: Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC can be dosed in small amounts to obtain water reduction from 10–15 %, and will achieve water reduction up to more than 30 % at high dosage rates. High Plasticity and neutral set. The superplasticizing action of Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC provides high slump, flowing concrete that maintains excellent workability with minimal set delay. The high range water reduction of Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC provides the following benefits in concrete:
    - Ideal for the production of wet shotcrete.
    - High early compressive strength for earlier removal of forms and structural use of concrete.
    - High ultimate strength allow for greater engineering design flexibility and structural economies.
    - Reduced water cement ratios produce more durable, denser concrete with reduced permeability.
    - Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC has been formulated to provide maximum water reduction, increased early strength, improved durability.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Liquid, clear brown
    - Specific gravity: 1.06 litre/kg approx.
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 10 litre drum
    - Shelf life: 12 months if stored as directed
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°and 35 ° C, protected from direct sunlight and frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC is compatible with most of the Sika admixtures with the exception of Sikament® NN.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Dosage rates will vary according to materials used, ambient conditions and the requirements of a specific project. Sika recommends dosage at 300–1000 ml/100 kg of cementitious for general concrete applications. If maximum water reduction is required, dosage up 1500 ml/100 kg of cementitious may be used. In Shotcrete the typical dosage ranges between 750 ml and 1500 ml/100kg of cementitious materials. Dosage rates outside the recommended range may be used where specialized materials such as microsilica are specified, extreme ambient conditions are encountered or unusual project conditions require special consideration. Please contact your Sika representative for more information and assistance.
4.4 Dispensing. Dry batching plant. Dose Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC with 80% of the mixing water then load all the remaining components, mix thoroughly for a minimum time of 60 seconds per cubic meter. Add the remaining 20% of batching water then. Wet batching plant; Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC may also be dispensed as an integral material during the regular admixture batching cycle of the concrete mixer. Do not add it to a dry mix
4.5 Further information.
    - Do not use in conjuction with naphthalene based admixtures.
    - May slightly increase air content of concrete at normal dose.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/sika_viscocrete_-190sc.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete® 190 SC, version 22/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/MSDS%20Sika%C2%AE%20ViscoCrete%C2%AE%20190%20SC%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC, version 11/12/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sds-sika-viscocrete-190sc.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® ViscoCrete®-190 SC, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/epd-sika-viscocrete-190sc.pdf
    - Brochure: Sika Viscocrete 190 SC Brochure 2020.pdf, version 02/06/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/Sika%20Viscocrete%20190%20SC%20Brochure%202020.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
